div.div:
circŭm-erro , āre, v. n.,
I.to wander round, stroll about: “neque turba lateri circumerrat,” Sen. Contr. 2, 9, 7 : tempora (of the revolution of Saturn in his orbit), to pass through, App. de Mundo, p. 71, 11.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
